educationalGoal:
Learning objectives to master:
(1) Stoichiometry, including mass balance and energy balance.
(2) Chemical thermodynamics, including chemical equilibria and chemical kinetics.
(3) Transportation phenomena of heat, mass, and momentum.
(4) Design of chemical devices and processes.
(5) Problem solving using the knowledge gained in areas above.

achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Can explain and calculate basic mass and energy balance.
(2) Can explain and calculate basic chemical thermodynamics, including chemical equilibrium and chemical kinetics.
(3) Can explain and calculate basic transportation phenomena of heat, mass, and momentum.
(4) Can design basic chemical processes.
(5) Can solve some problems using chemical engineering.
